sources.name: Greenhouse Job Board API
sources.notes: Employer-specific public GET endpoints require a board token obtained from the employer's career page. No global company search. Authenticate the employer-to-board relationship; GET access does not authorize application POSTs.

sources.name: Lever Postings API
sources.notes: Read published postings for a known employer site identifier. Use the correct global/EU instance and preserve hosted/apply URLs. Do not infer US eligibility from remote labels or automate applications.

sources.name: Ashby public Job Postings API
sources.notes: Public endpoint is scoped to a known employer job-board name. List only isListed=true results; preserve location and workplaceType. Compensation may be absent. Connect the board to the employer's official careers page before trusting it.

sources.name: USAJOBS
sources.notes: Public job announcements; the optional Search API requires an issued API key and registered-email User-Agent. Check each announcement's hiring path, citizenship, clearance, closing date/time, and current resume instructions. Account and agency workflow are needed to apply.

sources.name: LinkedIn Jobs
sources.notes: Use manual discovery or user-provided job links; public previews may be incomplete. LinkedIn restricts scraping and unauthorized automated access. Revalidate job ID, location, salary, and status on the employer's official posting.

sources.name: Indeed US
sources.notes: Use manual discovery or an explicitly permitted connector; Indeed restricts automated/agentic access without permission. Review fetch redirected to a non-US locale, so explicitly choose United States and verify location on the employer posting.

sources.name: Glassdoor Jobs
sources.notes: Public landing page was readable; full listings, reviews, and salary data may require login. Salary estimates and employee reviews are context, not employer commitments. Verify actual compensation and opening status at the employer.

sources.name: Handshake
sources.notes: Career network useful for students and early-career applicants. Job availability can depend on account, institution, and employer eligibility settings. Public marketing access does not verify access to a particular job or application.

sources.name: Wellfound
sources.notes: Startup and technology roles; account features and applications may require login. Distinguish salary from equity and check remote hiring geography and sponsorship on the employer's original posting.

sources.name: Built In
sources.notes: Technology and startup discovery by US city or remote filter. Listings may be promoted or duplicated; confirm compensation, location restrictions, and an active requisition on the employer career site.

sources.name: Dice
sources.notes: Technology roles include staffing-agency and contract ads. Confirm the employer of record, W-2/contract classification, duration, location, and stated work authorization requirements; account features may require login.

sources.name: Idealist
sources.notes: Nonprofit and mission-focused roles. Select US locations and distinguish paid employment, internships, and volunteer opportunities. Confirm pay, working arrangement, and live application instructions with the organization.

sources.name: CareerOneStop
sources.notes: US Department of Labor-sponsored career, training, local job-center and search resources. Direct fetch returned 403; DOL's official job-seeker page confirms the service. Use the browser manually and verify listings at employers.

sources.name: BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook
sources.notes: Occupation-level duties, entry education, pay, and outlook. Check data year and occupation definition; national medians are not an individual offer, a local salary quote, or a job vacancy.

sources.name: O*NET OnLine
sources.notes: Use occupation titles, tasks, skills, and alternate titles to expand search vocabulary and assess transferable skills. Occupational descriptions are not hard requirements for every employer.

sources.name: USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub
sources.notes: Direct hub fetch failed; USCIS's FY2024 report confirms the URL and historical petitioner data. Historical petitions do not prove a current opening, sponsorship promise, or individual visa eligibility. Confirm current policy with the employer.

sources.name: DOL OFLC disclosure data
sources.notes: Official indexed page verified; direct fetch failed during review. Historical LCA/PERM and wage datasets can contain errors and lag. A filing or certification is not a current job, offered salary, visa approval, or sponsorship guarantee.

sources.name: Google Careers (employer example)
sources.notes: An example of a direct employer source, not a default target list. Filter US offices and confirm job-specific qualifications and remote scope. Expand to the user's selected employers rather than limiting discovery to technology companies.

sources.name: Microsoft Careers (employer example)
sources.notes: An example of a direct employer career portal. Select United States and read each requisition; search/results may need a browser and applications require an account. Employer name alone does not establish sponsorship.

sources.name: EducationUSA: graduate study
sources.notes: US Department of State guidance for international applicants. Use for degree structures and search planning; institution and program pages control current admissions requirements, funding, deadlines, and international eligibility.

sources.name: NCES College Navigator
sources.notes: Direct root fetch failed; the official indexed advanced-degree search page was available. Use institution/program filters for discovery. Reported institutional data may lag and does not establish current program intake, deadlines, tuition, or funding.

sources.name: ED Database of Accredited Postsecondary Institutions and Programs
sources.notes: The search application returned no readable content; official ED/NCES pages confirm the service. Verify institution and relevant program with the accreditor; reported data may lag. Accreditation is distinct from SEVP certification and admission.

sources.name: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program
sources.notes: Current solicitation controls eligible fields, prior graduate study, and deadlines. NSF 26-526 requires US citizenship, nationality, or permanent residency by application and acceptance; international student status alone is insufficient. Do not promise funding or carry old eligibility rules forward.

sources.name: NSF Award Search
sources.notes: Award Search UI returned no readable records; its official overview and export guidance were readable. Use PI, institution, topic, and award dates to find relevant labs. An award does not show remaining money or a currently funded student/postdoc opening.

sources.name: NIH RePORTER
sources.notes: RePORTER is browser/JavaScript-based; official API documentation was readable. Use project/PI records to find relevant research, then verify current lab recruitment and funding directly. A project total is not a student stipend or available hiring budget.

sources.name: NIH Research Training and Career Development
sources.notes: Follow the specific active funding notice for predoctoral/postdoctoral mechanisms. Citizenship/residency, degree stage, sponsor, institutional nomination, and appointment rules vary; a general training page does not establish personal eligibility or an available slot.

sources.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
sources.notes: Select the applicant's home-country administering commission or embassy. Availability, nationality/residency rules, degree support, placement routes, and deadlines vary by country and competition; US graduate admission and a scholarship award are separate outcomes.

sources.name: Stanford Graduate Admissions (institution example)
sources.notes: Official MA/MS/PhD program directory; embedded program search may need a browser. Follow each department's current intake and central graduate requirements. Example source only: do not assume Stanford is the user's target or generalize its funding policies.

sources.name: MIT graduate degree programs (institution example)
sources.notes: Directory links to departments and deadlines. Check degree availability, application cycle/year, exact timezone, and separate funding deadlines in the department. Some master's routes have special eligibility; a department name is not proof of a terminal MS intake.

sources.name: UC Berkeley graduate programs (institution example)
sources.notes: Program directory includes degree, intake, and GRE filters. Distinguish professional/self-supporting master's, research degrees, and programs restricted to current students. Reconcile central and department requirements for the intended year before ranking.

sources.name: Carnegie Mellon SCS graduate admissions (department example)
sources.notes: Example of department-level MS/PhD instructions and program-specific deadlines. SCS, MHCI, and dual-degree routes differ. Read the named program's prompts, test policies, fees, advisor process, and funding; do not apply one route's rules to another.

sources.name: DHS Study in the States: School Search
sources.notes: Direct base URL fetch failed; official indexed search content confirmed the service. Verify the specific campus/program's SEVP status with the live tool and designated school official. Certification does not establish academic accreditation, admission, or visa approval.

sources.name: ETS TOEFL
sources.notes: Authoritative for current TOEFL formats, scoring, registration, and reporting. The graduate program decides accepted test versions, minimums, validity window, waivers, and score-arrival deadline; do not infer requirements from test-provider marketing.

sources.name: ETS GRE
sources.notes: Authoritative for General/Subject Test logistics and score reporting. A program may require, accept optionally, or refuse GRE scores. Read the specific admission cycle before advising testing or sending scores.

sources.name: IELTS
sources.notes: Official test information and recognition lookup. Confirm the accepted test type/delivery format, section minimums, validity, and waiver rules with the specific graduate program; provider recognition alone is insufficient.

sources.name: HigherEdJobs
sources.notes: Direct homepage/faculty fetch exposed only an iframe, and the about page was inaccessible. Treat as a manual discovery source until current listings are inspected. Separate faculty, administrative, adjunct, and postdoc roles and verify each at the institution.

sources.name: Higher Education Recruitment Consortium (HERC)
sources.notes: Consortium source for academic and staff roles, with regional and dual-career resources. Confirm campus, position category, employment fraction, review date, and application path on the hiring institution's official listing.

sources.name: The Chronicle of Higher Education Jobs
sources.notes: Homepage fetch failed; official indexed category pages confirmed the board. Search results can include promoted out-of-region roles and stale ads. Check the actual location, tenure status, appointment length, and live institutional requisition.

sources.name: Academic Jobs Online
sources.notes: Public position browsing with separate applicant/reference-writer accounts. Employer-linked postings may be the canonical application destination; preserve document and reference requirements. Do not access confidential letters or presume a listed ad is still accepting applications.

sources.name: Interfolio Faculty Search
sources.notes: Product URL redirects to Elsevier's Interfolio page. Find institution-specific public position links through official faculty/HR pages; this is not a universal job-search API. Applications/Dossier require an account and letter services may have separate terms.

sources.name: University of Michigan Careers (institution example)
sources.notes: Official campus employment portal; select faculty/research or relevant staff categories and confirm campus. Some faculty searches direct to a department or separate application system. The examples in this registry do not limit the user's institution search.

sources.name: UCLA Academic Recruit (institution example)
sources.notes: Official academic recruitment entry point and open recruitments. Record initial review date separately from final closing date, appointment rank/series, required statements, and reference procedure. Applicant login is needed for submission.

sources.name: NIH Intramural Postdoctoral Fellows
sources.notes: Official program, degree-recency and eligibility guidance. Follow current nationality/background-check restrictions and NIH international-services guidance; identify a specific PI/opening. Intramural postdoc rules differ from NIH extramural training grants.

sources.name: National Postdoctoral Association Career Center
sources.notes: Career-center fetch failed; NPA's official indexed directory confirms the destination. Use manual search for postdoctoral and related careers, then verify appointment type, duration, funding, benefits, and visa support directly with the host.

sources.name: AAAS Science Careers Jobs
sources.notes: Job-board fetch returned 403; AAAS's official indexed recruitment page confirmed the board. Global research roles require a US location filter. Ads are discovery evidence; check the lab/institution's opening and application process.

sources.name: Nature Careers
sources.notes: Job-board fetch returned 403; official Nature recruitment information confirms the service. Filter US roles and distinguish jobs, awards, and career articles. Read the host institution's posting for funding, appointment length, and eligibility.

sources.name: American Physical Society Careers
sources.notes: Official physics career page provides job search for academia, industry, and national labs. Linked board may need interactive/manual access. Apply US geography and role filters and confirm appointment/clearance requirements with the employer.

sources.name: ACM Career and Job Center
sources.notes: Root returned 403; official indexed board pages were available. Computing roles mix academic and industry jobs; filter carefully. Placeholder salary fields can be misleading, so use the employer's stated compensation rather than board defaults.

sources.name: MathJobs (American Mathematical Society)
sources.notes: Public mathematical-sciences positions worldwide; select US institutions. Applicant and reference-writer functions require accounts. Confirm each ad's deadline, rank, reference instructions, and whether the institution requires an additional application.

sources.name: American Historical Association Career Center
sources.notes: History/public-history job discovery with location and category filters. Includes non-US fellowships and non-faculty work; verify geography, appointment type, required materials, and current status at the host. Account features may require login.

sources.name: American Economic Association JOE Network
sources.notes: Economics hiring source with academic and nonacademic roles. Global listings require US filtering. Confirm recruitment cycle, interviews, references, and whether applying via JOE also requires the employer's application.

sources.name: Modern Language Association Job List
sources.notes: Job List returned 403; an official MLA platform announcement linked the current destination. Literature/language searches require manual inspection and US filtering; confirm specialization, teaching load, contract/tenure status, and institutional deadlines.

sources.name: ORISE internships and fellowships / Zintellect
sources.notes: Official ORISE page links Zintellect opportunities for graduates, postdocs, and faculty. These are not automatically degree admissions or employee jobs. Each sponsor sets citizenship, degree-recency, stipend, benefits, and appointment rules.

sources.name: PubMed
sources.notes: Biomedical/life-science literature supports PI/lab fit and recent research mapping. Check author identity and current institutional affiliation. Publication activity does not prove advising availability, admission odds, lab funding, or a vacancy.
